text.en: Canadian citizens have rights, and they also have responsibilities.
text.fr: Les citoyens canadiens ont des droits, et ils ont aussi des responsabilités.

source.quote: Canadian citizens have rights and responsibilities.

verification.evidence: Canadian citizens have rights and responsibilities.

text.en: These rights and responsibilities come to us from Canada's history. Canadian law protects them, and they reflect the traditions, identity and values Canadians share.
text.fr: Ces droits et ces responsabilités nous viennent de l'histoire du Canada. Les lois canadiennes les protègent, et ils reflètent les traditions, l'identité et les valeurs que partagent les Canadiens.

source.quote: These come to us from our history, are secured by Canadian law, and reflect our shared traditions, identity, and values.

verification.evidence: Canadian citizens have rights and responsibilities. These come to us from our history, are secured by Canadian law, and reflect our shared traditions, identity, and values.

text.en: Canadian law comes from several places. They include laws made by Parliament and by the provincial legislatures, English common law, France's civil code, and the unwritten constitution Canada received from Great Britain.
text.fr: Le droit canadien a plusieurs sources. On y trouve les lois adoptées par le Parlement et par les assemblées législatives des provinces, la common law anglaise, le code civil de la France et la constitution non écrite que le Canada a reçue de la Grande-Bretagne.

source.quote: Canadian law has several sources, including laws passed by Parliament and the provincial legislatures, English common law, the civil code of France and the unwritten constitution that we have inherited from Great Britain.

verification.evidence: Canadian law has several sources, including laws passed by Parliament and the provincial legislatures, English common law, the civil code of France and the unwritten constitution that we have inherited from Great Britain.

text.en: Together, these sources give Canadians a tradition of ordered liberty that is 800 years old. It goes back to Magna Carta, also called the Great Charter of Freedoms, which was signed in England in 1215.
text.fr: Ensemble, ces sources donnent aux Canadiens une tradition de liberté ordonnée vieille de 800 ans. Elle remonte à la Magna Carta, aussi appelée la Grande Charte des libertés, signée en Angleterre en 1215.

text.en: Habeas corpus is the right to challenge the state when it holds a person against the law. This right comes from English common law.
text.fr: L'habeas corpus est le droit de contester l'État lorsqu'il détient une personne illégalement. Ce droit vient de la common law anglaise.

source.quote: Habeas corpus, the right to challenge unlawful detention by the state, comes from English common law.

verification.evidence: Habeas corpus, the right to challenge unlawful detention by the state, comes from English common law.
